prompts.name: ready-to-promote-dev-to-staging
prompts.prompt: I want to promote app-a from dev to staging. Run the preflight checks and tell me whether we're ready and what the scope would be.

prompts.name: source-not-converged
prompts.prompt: Preflight promotion from staging to prod for app-a. Two Units in staging still have unapplied changes — is that a problem?

prompts.name: scope-narrowing
prompts.prompt: I want to promote only the API-related Units (not the workers) from app-a-staging to app-a-prod. Can you scope the preflight to just those?

prompts.name: staging-to-prod-bulk
prompts.prompt: Preflight says we're good to promote app-a from staging to prod. Scope is the app-a-home/app-a-app filter, 12 Units, ChangeSet name release-20260415. Run the promotion.

prompts.name: single-unit-promotion
prompts.prompt: I only need to promote the app-a-api Unit from staging to prod — a single Unit. Do I still need a ChangeSet?

prompts.name: base-to-fleet-upgrade
prompts.prompt: I have a base chart Unit in app-a-home named app-a-base. I want to push its latest revision to every downstream Unit in all env-Spaces at once. How?
